mainEntity.name: How do I know if I actually need bathroom accessibility modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eligibility usually depends on the mobility, balance, or caregiving needs of the person using the bathroom, not just age. A bathroom that works for someone who only needs grab bars may be very different from one designed for a wheelchair, walker, or assisted transfer.
acceptedAnswer.description: If stepping over the tub, turning in the room, or using the toilet and sink safely is becoming difficult, you likely need modifications tailored to the user’s mobility level.
